name: freeway_cross
_tests: two FREEWAY-class roads crossing, one carried over the other on piers. Nothing in the corpus did this: ring_city carries a freeway over ARTERIALS, and every imported city is one ring with diamonds, so a structure between two high-rank roads — and a hold wide enough to span a whole carriageway pair — was never exercised.
_terrain_note: flat on purpose: this scene is about the crossing. Relief is freeway_cross_relief's job, and sustained grade is steep_climb's.

edges._floor: the hold has to clear BOTH east-west carriageways, which span y in [-19,-3] and [3,19] — hence a 30 m half-span, not a point
